variables: n is initial number of players
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all 2^(n/2) match outcomes for each round leads to combinatorial explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing states over (m, p1, p2) bounds distinct subproblems to O(n^3) with polynomial transitions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the symmetry p1 > m - p2 + 1 and accounts for middle players correctly when m is odd.

hints.title: State Representation by Player Ranks
hints.text: The tournament structure preserves symmetry, allowing the game state to depend solely on current player count and ranks of both favorites.

hints.title: Meeting Base Case
hints.text: The favorites meet in the immediate round if and only if their ranks sum to the current player count plus one.

hints.title: Partitioning Survivors Across Round Matchups
hints.text: Iterate over all possible numbers of survivors from match pairings preceding and between the favorites to transition to the next tournament stage.

hints.title: Full Implementation

solutions.approach: State memoization over player count and favorite ranks
